description: This file defines configuration options and utility functions for creating Slack WebClient instances, including default retry configurations and option resolution functions.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions { resolveSlackWebClientOptions
methods.description: Resolves and merges default Slack WebClient options with user-provided options, assigning default retry configuration if not provided.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions/ resolveSlackWriteClientOptions
methods.description: Resolves and merges default Slack Write Client options with user-provided options, assigning default write retry configuration if not provided.

methods.name: export function createSlackWebClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWebClient
methods.description: Creates a new Slack WebClient instance with specified token and options.

methods.name: export function createSlackWriteClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWriteClient
methods.description: Creates a new Slack WebClient instance for writing operations with specified token and options.
